question:
A full-wave bridge rectifier uses a transformer secondary of $12\,\text{V}_{\text{rms}}$ at $50\,\text{Hz}$. Each diode has a constant forward drop of $0.7\,\text{V}$.

A capacitor filter $C=1000\,\mu\text{F}$ is connected across the load $R_L=1.0\,\text{k}\Omega$.

Assuming small ripple and that the capacitor charges to the peak value each half-cycle, estimate:

(a) the DC output voltage $V_{DC}$,

(b) the peak-to-peak ripple voltage $V_{r(pp)}$.
